scope: Remaining item equipment and appearance pages. Amulets and rings already reviewed separately are unchanged. Definitions and artwork from public client only; no signed-in connection or character actions.

foolsHatUnusual.name: unusual fool's hat

vulcanus.description: Scholars agree this weapon should never have been forged. It is an affront to nature itself, and playing god has never ended well for mortals.
vulcanus.name: Vulcanus

trainingFishingRod.name: training fishing rod

trainingPickaxe.name: training pickaxe

sourStomach.description: Woodcutting double ups have a $curr% chance ($min-$max) to build 2-6 hunger, stinging you for 1-3 damage. At 10 hunger, your next woodcutting double up triggers twice and eats your equipped apple pie.
sourStomach.lore: Too much apple pie has soured your stomach, yet one more slice always seems like the cure.
sourStomach.name: Sour Stomach

bloodWard.description: Upon casting a blood rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to take 5 damage and build up a protective ward that absorbs up to 30 damage and lasts 30s.
bloodWard.lore: Pay in blood; be spared in kind.
bloodWard.name: Blood Ward

drosswork.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to make a chunk of dross when forging an item
drosswork.name: Drosswork

chaosConduit.description: Upon casting a chaos rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to spend a mind rune instead of the chaos rune.
chaosConduit.name: Chaos Conduit

illOmen.description: Curses you when landing a spell for damage ending in 4, causing your next spell to hit for only 1 damage. $curr% ($min-$max) chance.
illOmen.lore: The unlucky numbers were never meant to be struck.
illOmen.name: Ill Omen

soulHarvest.description: Upon killing an enemy with a death rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to gain your overkill damage as mind runes.
soulHarvest.lore: Nothing is wasted, not even excess.
soulHarvest.name: Soul Harvest

shepherd.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain 6 crafting experience when shearing sheep
shepherd.lore: Shearing sheep is a delicate art, mastered only by the most patient farmers.
shepherd.name: Shepherd

ironGut.description: Mining double ups have a $curr% chance ($min-$max) to build 2-6 hunger, stinging you for 1-3 damage. At 10 hunger, your next mining double up triggers twice and eats your equipped meat pie.
ironGut.lore: Your gut can handle anything. Your fingers, less so.
ironGut.name: Iron Gut

empoweredMind.description: Upon casting a mind rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to gain Empowered Mind for 22s: +2 Wind Strike and Fire Strike max damage.
empoweredMind.name: Empowered Mind

quench.description: Consume a chunk of dross when forging an item of steel or better to gain a stack of Quenched, reducing the coal required to smelt that metal's bar by $curr% ($min-$max)
quench.name: Quench

sweetTooth.description: Fishing double ups have a $curr% chance ($min-$max) to build 2-6 hunger, stinging you for 1-3 damage. At 10 hunger, your next fishing double up triggers twice and eats your equipped redberry pie.
sweetTooth.lore: Your mind keeps drifting to redberry pie, and your hooks keep catching your fingers.
sweetTooth.name: Sweet Tooth

gildedPockets.lore: Ancient scarab magic blesses this cache with impossible depth.
gildedPockets.name: Gilded Pockets

shellPockets.lore: The scarab shells create hidden folds in the fabric of space.
shellPockets.name: Shell Pockets

serpentsReturn.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for arrows to return to you when fighting from safe spots.
serpentsReturn.lore: The arrow slithers back to its master like a loyal serpent.
serpentsReturn.name: Serpent's Return

mudwright.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain 6 crafting experience when mining clay
mudwright.lore: Using a shovel was the idea of a particularly lazy mud dwarf.
mudwright.name: Mudwright

windBlast.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires three air runes and a death rune.
windBlast.name: Wind Blast

windBolt.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires two air runes and a chaos rune.
windBolt.name: Wind Bolt

flameGlutton.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to burn 2-8 logs at once, granting experience for each, but less ash
flameGlutton.lore: The remnants of ancient flames still hunger for fuel.
flameGlutton.name: Flame Glutton

cursedStrength.description: Doubles your physical damage and delay with two handed weapons.
cursedStrength.name: Cursed Strength

parry.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) of parrying enemy melee attacks while wielding any staff, or a two handed melee weapon.
parry.lore: Where others see a weapon, the disciplined see a fortress.
parry.name: Parry

dreadAura.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to make your foe skip its attack.
dreadAura.lore: A chilling aura emanates from the blackened steel, freezing foes with dread.
dreadAura.name: Dread Aura

sacredMarch.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain a spirit rune when dealing damage.
sacredMarch.lore: Despite the ordinary design, you can feel a faint rhythm pulsing from these boots.
sacredMarch.name: Sacred March

swiftSands.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to travel quickly to your destination.
swiftSands.lore: The bone remembers paths through the shifting sands.
swiftSands.name: Swift Sands

rasSplinter.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to find gold ore when cutting yew or magic trees.
rasSplinter.lore: The sun god's blessing transmutes wood to gold.
rasSplinter.name: Ra's Splinter

steadyAim.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to deal 1 additional ranged damage.
steadyAim.name: Steady Aim

timberOracle.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) of getting an additional, random log type when chopping trees
timberOracle.name: Timber Oracle

mixedEarth.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when mining copper or tin, to mine whichever one you have the least of
mixedEarth.name: Mixed Earth

baker.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to double experience from cooking bread
baker.name: Baker

darkTwist.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max), when a spell would hit for 1, to deal your max hit instead.
darkTwist.lore: Failure, bent back on itself, becomes fury.
darkTwist.name: Dark Twist

spellEcho.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when a spell hits for its max damage or more, to cast your next spell quickly.
spellEcho.lore: The magic lingers, hungry for a second breath.
spellEcho.name: Spell Echo

thickSkin.description: A prayer that increases your defense by 10. Consumes one spirit rune per enemy attack.
thickSkin.name: Thick Skin

dragonRage.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) on a melee swing to spit a fireball at your target for up to 10 fire damage.
dragonRage.name: Dragon Rage
dragonRage.setBonusDescription: With at least two dragon items equipped: taking any fire damage increases your strength by one, for 60s. Stacks up to 20.

innerFurnace.description: Stores $curr% ($min-$max) of the fire damage you take (for 60s, refreshing) and unleashes it as a fireball at the next enemy to land a melee hit on you. Requires a shield equipped.
innerFurnace.name: Inner Furnace

bloodscent.description: When swinging at a target below 25% HP, $curr% chance ($min-$max) to swing 3 times.
bloodscent.name: Bloodscent

plumeCatcher.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to obtain a feather when fishing
plumeCatcher.lore: You pick up the feathers dropped by nearby seagulls. Oh, it looks good on this hat!
plumeCatcher.name: Plume Catcher

fireBlast.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires five fire runes, three air runes, and a death rune.
fireBlast.name: Fire Blast

fireBolt.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires four fire runes, two air runes, and a chaos rune.
fireBolt.name: Fire Bolt

fletchersEye.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to double experience from fletching
fletchersEye.name: Fletcher's Eye

lightBite.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to keep your feather, shrimp or frog bait when fishing
lightBite.name: Light Bite

greenThumb.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to double the yield when picking grain or flax
greenThumb.name: Green Thumb

coalKeeper.description: Chance to use one less coal per ore smelted or superheated. Your chance is ( 10 + Firemaking level + Ability level )%
coalKeeper.lore: The fire dwarves' wisdom is passed down through these gloves.
coalKeeper.name: Coal Keeper

bountyHook.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to catch double the fish and gain double fishing experience
bountyHook.name: Bounty Hook

pulverizeIron.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) of destroying the iron you just mined, gaining 50% more experience
pulverizeIron.name: Pulverize Iron

windWave.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires seven air runes and a blood rune.
windWave.name: Wind Wave

scarabsFeast.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to steal 1 HP when swinging for more than 5 damage and the enemy is not at full health.
scarabsFeast.lore: The scarab god hungers for the life force of the wounded.
scarabsFeast.name: Scarab's Feast

ignitingShot.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to cast Fire Strike as you shoot. Requires appropriate runes.
ignitingShot.name: Igniting Shot

rapidFire.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to shoot again. Can trigger itself.
rapidFire.name: Rapid Fire

fireStrike.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires three fire runes and a mind rune.
fireStrike.name: Fire Strike

moltenReflection.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to reflect fire spell damage back at the caster.
moltenReflection.lore: The mirror remembers the flames that gave it form.
moltenReflection.name: Molten Reflection

gracedAim.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to deal 2 damage instead of missing.
gracedAim.name: Graced Aim

burstOfStrength.description: A prayer that increases your strength by 10. Consumes one spirit rune per attack.
burstOfStrength.name: Burst of Strength

clarityOfThought.description: A prayer that increases your attack by 10. Consumes one spirit rune per attack.
clarityOfThought.name: Clarity of Thought

toughArrows.description: $curr% reduced chance ($min-$max) for your arrows to break.
toughArrows.name: Tough Arrows

lanternsGift.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to also mine a piece of coal when mining any ore underground
lanternsGift.lore: The moth lantern's glow reveals hidden coal veins in the darkness.
lanternsGift.name: Lantern's Gift

anglersLuck.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to catch a magic carp instead of your usual catch
anglersLuck.name: Angler's Luck

crusader.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) on swing to gain +100 strength for 24s.
crusader.name: Crusader

sacredStrike.description: When using a progrite weapon, $curr% chance ($min-$max) to swing twice at demons.
sacredStrike.lore: Holy by nature, the progrite in this weapon hums against demonkind, guiding the blade to strike again.
sacredStrike.name: Sacred Strike

protectorOfProgryn.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for your active prayers to also trigger on allies fighting the same monster.
protectorOfProgryn.name: Protector of Progryn
protectorOfProgryn.setBonusDescription: With 2+ progrite items equipped: up to 50% chance to gain a spirit rune each time you attack, based on ability level.

penance.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain a spirit rune when taking 10 or more damage.
penance.name: Penance

fanaticism.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when obtaining a spirit rune while meleeing to gain Fanaticism, making your next two swings quick. Consumes a blood rune.
fanaticism.name: Fanaticism

pyreshellWard.description: Reduces damage from dragon's fire breath by $curr% ($min-$max)
pyreshellWard.name: Pyreshell Ward

patronage.description: Every two minutes, tosses 2-10 of your coins to another player in your zone.
patronage.name: Patronage

saltCure.description: When cooking on a fire, 20% chance to burn food, but $curr% bonus cooking XP ($min-$max). Burning still grants XP.
saltCure.lore: Heavy-handed seasoning ruins some dishes, but the lessons stick.
saltCure.name: Salt Cure

forbiddenMagic.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for your spell to deal 50% more damage but also strike you for the full amount, though never enough to kill.
forbiddenMagic.name: Forbidden Magic

sanguineHarvest.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain a blood rune when slaying an enemy with more than 100 maximum HP.
sanguineHarvest.name: Sanguine Harvest

scarabsPlea.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to heal 1 HP when taking 4 or more damage.
scarabsPlea.lore: The sacred scarab intercedes on behalf of its bearer.
scarabsPlea.name: Scarab's Plea

deathsBargain.description: Lets you perform the Dark Ritual at the Totem of Zem. $curr% ($min-$max) chance to not consume the cut diamond.
deathsBargain.lore: The dead pay your debts, for a price.
deathsBargain.name: Death's Bargain

rubberBody.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for an enemy swing to bounce off you.
rubberBody.lore: Gurgle never felt a thing either.
rubberBody.name: Rubber Body

windStrike.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires an air rune and a mind rune.
windStrike.name: Wind Strike

shieldWall.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to cap incoming damage to a maximum of 30% of your maximum HP with a shield equipped
shieldWall.name: Shield Wall

fireWave.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires eight fire runes, five air runes, and a blood rune.
fireWave.name: Fire Wave

telegrabLoot.description: Telegrab the loot when killing an enemy from a safe spot. Requires a Law Rune. $curr% chance (1-60) of not spending the rune
telegrabLoot.name: Telegrab Loot

eruption.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) on a melee swing to deal the damage above 10 as fire to all enemies within 20 paces and to yourself.
eruption.name: Eruption

atAnyCost.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain 10% more experience by sacrificing an additional arrow.
atAnyCost.name: At Any Cost

quickHex.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to cast your first spell quickly.
quickHex.name: Quick Hex

focus.description: Your spells cast slower but each one hits for 20% more damage.
focus.name: Focus

sniper.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to deal maximum damage if the enemy is at full HP.
sniper.name: Sniper
